thread:
Maya Chen: Starting NovaRise onboarding kick-off thread. Need to align owners, acceptance criteria, high-risk items for renewal, and a tight timeline. Can folks confirm 30m sync next Wed (4/7) morning PT?
Priya Das: I can do Wed 4/7 9:30am PT. I'll own data ingestion + schema validation.
Tom O'Neill: +1 for 9:30. I'll own infra + deployment (Dedicated pool). Also flaging a potential renewal risk: finance wants usage estimate for Q3 to lock discounted rate.
Hannah Rivera: I'll run enablement and support onboarding. Plan: two 60m sessions (Admin + Dev) and a short runbook walkthrough.
Carlos Gutierrez: I'll handle acceptance criteria for quality metrics and monitor logs during pilot. Suggest we set an SLO for token-level error rate <0.5% and model drift alerts.
Maya Chen: Draft milestone map:
```
- Day 0: kickoff + stakeholder roster (Maya)
- Day 3: data ingestion tested (Priya)
- Week 1: infra deploy + perf baseline (Tom)
- Week 2: pilot + enablement (Hannah)
- Week 3: QA signoff + exec review (Carlos/Maya)
```
Maya Chen: Proposed acceptance criteria (short): 1) end-to-end demo from NovaRise UI; 2) pilot runs 5 business days with <0.5% errors and no critical incidents; 3) p95 latency <200ms for canonical prompts; 4) enablement completed and feedback form filled by 90% of devs/testers.
Tom O'Neill: Add: deployment rollback tested and startup time <120s. I'll add a short checklist in the runbook.
Priya Das: For ingestion, we need sample dataset and schema freeze. Can product provide canonical examples?
Maya Chen: Product will share canonical prompt & sample dataset by EOD Monday. Hannah, can you include a quick prompt capture template in prework?
Hannah Rivera: Yep — will add a 5-min prompt capture and a dev readiness checklist. Also using a 4-question pulse after enablement to capture confidence and open issues.
Carlos Gutierrez: On renewal risk: Tom, can you provide weekly usage projections so AE can present to finance? If projections look low, we may need to fast-track GA.
Tom O'Neill: I'll run a crude projection after the perf baseline (Week 1) and post it here.
Maya Chen: Calendar: scheduling kickoff Wed Apr 7 9:30am PT. OnboardBot, please send invite.
OnboardBot: Meeting created: NovaRise Onboarding Kickoff  Wed Apr 7 9:30 AM PT. Invite sent to participants. Link: https://calendar.service/meet/novarise-kickoff
Priya Das: Legal note: their infosec team asked for network diagram and data retention policy. I'll start a doc and loop security.
Maya Chen: Good call. Carlos, can you own the security checklist with SecOps?
Carlos Gutierrez: On it. I'll add the checklist to the onboarding doc and tag SecOps.
Hannah Rivera: Quick flow for enablement: 1) Admin walkthrough, 2) Dev quickstart, 3) Ops runbook. Each with a short lab.
Maya Chen: Action items (assign):
- Maya: finalize stakeholder roster + kickoff agenda (today)
- Priya: ingestion schema + security prelim doc (by Mon)
- Tom: deploy checklist + rollback test plan (by Apr 10)
- Hannah: enablement schedule + pulse form (by Apr 5)
- Carlos: QA SLOs + SecOps checklist (by Apr 6)
Maya Chen: Also, please flag any blockers here (legal, proc, infra). We need to hit pilot signoff by Apr 21 to stay on track for their procurement deadline (May 10).
Tom O'Neill: Noted. If we see infra delays, propose a short pilot on hosted tier as fallback.
Priya Das: I'll request sample dataset access from NovaRise and confirm data sharing agreement.
Hannah Rivera: I'll prep a short 1-page user guide for admins to reduce friction.
Carlos Gutierrez: Posted initial QA metrics doc: https://docs.internal/novarise-qa-metrics. Feedback welcome.
Maya Chen: Thanks team 44d We'll keep async updates here. If anything urgent arises before Wed, ping me directly.
Tom O'Neill: All good from infra side for now.
Priya Das: Adding sample data request note to the doc.
Hannah Rivera: Prework checklist added to the shared doc.
OnboardBot: Thread archived for inactivity after 8 hours.
